AzureAd.// XmlaAuthenticationMode: Auto (DeviceCode for AzureCli dev mode, else Shared) | Shared | DeviceCode. XMLA rejects Azure CLI tokens.

Export.// Notes: Exports stream one DAX query over XMLA. MaxRows 0 = unlimited; CommandTimeoutSeconds 0 = no timeout. EnableBenchmark exposes POST /export/bench (read-only perf baseline; infra/perf-export.ps1) - keep off in production.

MetadataCache.// Notes: Caches downloaded TOM metadata and (when report measures are used) report definitions so exports don't re-hit Fabric getDefinition. TtlMinutes <= 0 = never expire until restart/refresh. The disk cache survives restarts: delete DiskCacheDirectory (default %TEMP%/pbivisualexport-metadata-cache) after a deployment to force a reload. RefreshOnMissSeconds: re-download once, if older than this, when a field isn't found (<= 0 disables).
